proposed_from.topic: Rational cubic identification and correction of the one-proxy LvLiNGAM boundary. Observe iid X=(X1,X2,X3) from X=(I-B)^(-1)(gamma H+D_s xi), where B is one of six labeled positive two-edge chains, edge coefficients and global loadings lie in [1/4,3/4], residual scales lie in [3/4,5/4], and the four independent centered sources have support in [-2,2], variance one and third cumulant in [1/2,1]. Prove that C3 alone globally identifies the chain and both coefficients: the unique rank-two cubic slice identifies the root, its signed kernel identifies the middle, and explicit adjugate contractions recover both edges with uniform denominator bounds. On the exact Tramontano-Kivva-Salehkaleybar-Drton-Kiyavash one-proxy graph, reproduce and saturate the released Macaulay2 elimination, reconcile Theorem 3.6, and characterize genuine nonidentification versus removable chart failures outside the positive chamber. Prove covariance-only opposite-chain overlap on a nonempty open set. Give a constant-time rational algorithm and bounded-data moment-inversion confidence set with uniform finite-sample coverage and root-n diameter on denominator-separated subclasses, without requiring nonsingular influence covariance. Consumer: replace the fourth-cumulant proxy branch in CEId-from-Moments by a certified cubic branch on the positive-skew class, with ambiguity warnings on the audited failure divisor. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Independent algebra derived M_a=hx gg'+r dd', kernel k=(-uz,z+vy,-y), N=hxr(uyz,-y(z+vy),y^2), W=-hxrt yz(0,1,v), and the rational edge formulas; it also derived slice determinants and uniform denominators. Exact arithmetic recovered u=1/2,v=2/5 in the legal Bernoulli witness, 1,200 numerical relabelings passed, and an interior reversal-symmetric covariance witness had an invertible nuisance Jacobian. The released covariance equations and 60 cubic residual equations were reconstructed; a linear elimination certificate and localized generic degree one were derived. Hoeffding moment rectangles yielded honest inversion and root-n diameter without covariance inversion. Same-box twins, scaling, source permutations, graph-transpose conventions, zero denominators, negative-sign failures, singular moment covariance, bounded-source realizability were checked; no correction or collision was found. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Classify all real coefficient/order fibers outside the positive box, especially intersections of rank and denominator hypersurfaces, separating genuine ambiguity from removable adjugate-chart failures. EARLY KILL TEST: Run the pinned Macaulay2 file, reduce beta*W_b-W_c against its full elimination ideal, and localize at W_b; a nonzero remainder or retained generic second full-system root stops the correction claim. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest published result is Tramontano et al. (2025), Theorem 3.6, which reports that the effect is not identifiable from cumulants through order three on the exact fixed graph. The independent full-ideal theorem tests a precisely specified additional relation, \(\beta W_2^{\mathrm{el}}-W_3^{\mathrm{el}}=0\), under the exact released parameterization, with zero remainder against the pinned entire basis as a mandatory first checkpoint; it makes no claim about which subset of the published computation supported Theorem 3.6. The positive-class theorem is stronger in a different direction because it recovers the unknown order and both direct coefficients globally from \(C_3\) alone with explicit denominator margins. Cai et al. (2023) and Schkoda, Robeva, and Drton (2024) supply the nearest cumulant-factorization and rank techniques, but require covariance with a fourth cumulant or stacked orders and do not deliver this recovery map. Exact-title, theorem-number, code, and target-method searches through September 14, 2026 found no closer paper or public full-basis re-audit that subsumes either theorem.

seed_details.seed: Positive-chamber global cubic inverse for all six labeled one-factor chains
seed_details.anchor_locator: Tramontano et al. (2025), Theorem 3.6 and Appendix C.1.1; Cai et al. (2023), Theorem 2 and Appendix A.1
seed_details.live_opportunity: The unrestricted real calculation does not decide whether its alleged second branch enters a compact positive-sign chamber, while the one-latent cumulant factorization leaves a rank-two slice whose kernel has an order-specific sign pattern.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace root enumeration for a bivariate polynomial by a joint three-variable tensor-slice rank test, then use the signed kernel before any division.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the pair \(\{\)third cumulant, positive one-proxy chain\(\}\) and for rank-two cubic-slice LiNGAM recovery returned no closer theorem than the two anchors.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The result is immediate from Cai et al. because their one-latent-component ratios already recover a mixing matrix.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their displayed closed form uses covariance and fourth cumulants for a two-block component, whereas this seed identifies an unknown label and two directed edges from the joint cubic tensor alone.

seed_details.seed: Localized linear elimination certificate correcting the apparent quadratic proxy fiber
seed_details.anchor_locator: Tramontano et al. (2025), proof of Theorem 3.6 and released Macaulay2 file; Garcia-Puente et al. (2010), Propositions 2--4
seed_details.live_opportunity: The published proof reads nonidentification from one quadratic generator, while the full elimination ideal may contain a linear target relation after localization.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Reduce the explicit linear relation against the full elimination ideal and compute the target degree over the observable function field instead of counting roots of one generator.
seed_details.destination_search: Exact-title, theorem-number, code-repository, and correction searches found the published claim and derivative summaries but no public correction or full-ideal localization analysis.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A quadratic in a reduced Groebner basis already proves a two-valued generic fiber by Garcia-Puente et al.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those propositions require the full elimination ideal; a single quadratic can be a multiple of a linear generator over the observable function field.

seed_details.seed: Complete real semialgebraic atlas of exceptional cubic fibers
seed_details.anchor_locator: Tramontano et al. (2025), Theorem 3.6; Garcia-Puente et al. (2010), Section 2; Drton, Foygel, and Sullivant (2011), global-versus-generic injectivity criterion
seed_details.live_opportunity: Neither generic elimination nor one rational chart distinguishes removable denominator failures from genuine twins on intersections of exceptional hypersurfaces.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a single localization by saturation on every nonzero slice-minor chart, followed by real primary decomposition and fiber-cardinality certification.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for real fiber stratification of the one-proxy LvLiNGAM moment map found global-identifiability frameworks but no chart-complete semialgebraic atlas for this model.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The atlas is a routine computer-algebra appendix once the generic inverse is known.
seed_details.rebuttal: Rank-drop and denominator intersections can carry positive-dimensional fibers, finite twins, or alternate rational charts, and real feasibility is not resolved by generic degree.
seed_details.disposition: keep as the first-class open question

seed_details.seed: Finite-sample honest inversion of bounded cubic moments without covariance inversion
seed_details.anchor_locator: Tramontano et al. (2025), Section 4 and conclusion; Babii (2020), concentration-based confidence-set construction; Andrews and Guggenberger (2019), singularity-robust test inversion
seed_details.live_opportunity: The published estimator has no coverage theory, and ordinary delta-method inference is nonregular at rational failure divisors or singular moment covariance.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Invert a simultaneous bounded-moment rectangle over all six exact charts before selecting a label.
seed_details.destination_search: The target-method search found singularity-robust asymptotic GMM and honest inverse-problem sets, but no finite-sample union-of-cubic-charts result.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Coverage follows immediately from Hoeffding's inequality.
seed_details.rebuttal: Coverage is elementary, but root-\(n\) contraction requires a uniform label-separation and rational inverse-Lipschitz theorem; this is retained as an inference rung rather than the kernel.
seed_details.disposition: fold into the selected kernel as an inference rung

seed_details.seed: Open covariance overlap of opposite positive chains
seed_details.anchor_locator: Ghassami et al. (2020), Definitions 1--2 and main equivalence theorem; Foygel Barber et al. (2022), Theorem 3.7
seed_details.live_opportunity: Known-graph covariance recovery does not determine whether distinct unknown chain labels have full-dimensional covariance-image intersections.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Form the fiber product of two chain-specific covariance maps and certify an interior common value by a submersion Jacobian.
seed_details.destination_search: Pairwise covariance-image overlap searches found general distribution equivalence and fixed-graph half-trek criteria, but no positive one-factor three-chain result.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Parameter counting already implies that the covariance images overlap.
seed_details.rebuttal: Dimension counts do not establish a real feasible common interior point; an exact interior witness and two nonsingular Jacobians do.
seed_details.disposition: fold into the selected kernel as the covariance impossibility contrast

seed_details.seed: Necessary-and-sufficient signed-kernel chamber for chain-order recovery
seed_details.anchor_locator: Tramontano et al. (2025), Figure 3 and Theorem 3.6; Cai et al. (2023), causal-order corollary
seed_details.live_opportunity: The positive chamber is sufficient, but the exact real sign inequalities under which a slice kernel orients the chain are not characterized.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Solve the kernel sign inequalities \(uz(z+vy)>0\) and \(uzy>0\) jointly with slice-rank conditions before recovering edges.
seed_details.destination_search: No paper in the adjacent cumulant-order literature gives an if-and-only-if signed-kernel chamber for this three-node latent-factor model.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is merely rewriting the coordinates of a cross product.
seed_details.rebuttal: A complete necessity direction must also construct observationally compatible order ambiguity outside the chamber; absent that, this seed is not yet a standalone kernel.
seed_details.disposition: drop as a standalone seed and absorb into the real-fiber question

seed_details.seed: Adaptive adjugate-chart atlas for rational recovery beyond positivity
seed_details.anchor_locator: Garcia-Puente et al. (2010), Example 1 and Propositions 3--4; Drton, Foygel, and Sullivant (2011), rational-identifiability analysis
seed_details.live_opportunity: A zero chosen adjugate column need not imply nonidentification because another column or kernel normalization can remain valid.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Enumerate all nonzero adjugate columns and select a chart using observable minors before forming rational contractions.
seed_details.destination_search: General rational-identifiability papers discuss exceptional sets but do not provide this model's constant-size observable chart selector.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Finite chart switching is a software detail with no theorem content.
seed_details.rebuttal: It becomes mathematical only when the chart union is proved equal to the identifiable locus; that equality is subsumed by the stronger fiber atlas.
seed_details.disposition: drop in favor of the complete atlas

seed_details.seed: Minimal cumulant-order frontier when selected source skewnesses vanish
seed_details.anchor_locator: Cai et al. (2023), Section 2 and Appendix A.1; Schkoda, Robeva, and Drton (2024), source-rank theorem and discussion
seed_details.live_opportunity: Existing procedures move to some higher nonzero cumulant when skewness vanishes, without an exact order frontier for the proxy-chain target.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the cubic slice by the first nonzero odd or even source-cumulant flattening and track which source columns remain distinguishable.
seed_details.destination_search: The adjacent papers provide sufficient orders depending on latent count but no exact source-pattern-dependent minimum for the fixed three-node proxy chain.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Choosing the next nonzero cumulant is immediate from multilinearity.
seed_details.rebuttal: Exact minimality requires lower-order twins for every vanishing pattern, but this direction is less valuable than resolving the already contested cubic boundary.
